name: Wagram

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Austrian quality wine from approved grape varieties, tested by the state before sale. Prädikatswein and DAC wines sit within it.
Districtus Austriae Controllatus, Austria's rules for regionally typical wines. The wine must show the typical character of its area.

blurb.text: A wine area in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, where Grüner Veltliner covers 56 percent of vineyards. Zweigelt follows at 12 percent, with Riesling, Roter Veltliner and Müller-Thurgau also grown.
